items.title: fix(agents): emit plan events for CLI progress_card tool results (#15…
items.summary: fix(agents): emit plan events for CLI progress_card tool results (#150903) * fix(agents): emit plan events for CLI progress_card tool results Claude CLI runs never projected progress_card into a plan event, so Telegram (and other channel) progress drafts showed generic tool rows instead of the checklist that Codex runs display. The CLI tool name also arrives MCP-prefixed (mcp__openclaw__progress_card), which the exact-name checks in the embedded handler would not have matched. Reuse the same shared projectProgressCardChannelUpdate contract the embedded runner uses, keyed off the prefix-stripped tool name via isAgentPlanProgressToolName, and emit the same "plan" stream event on a successful progress_card/update_plan result. Fixes #150805. * fix(agents): preserve CLI checklists through channel delivery Complete the current-source progress-card repair and exercise the real JSONL parser, correlated result handler, lifecycle bridge, and channel compositor. Preserve failure summaries, duplicate cleanup, delivery suppression, and the final answer. Original fix by chelsealong in #150903; retain the contributor commit as parent. Fixes #150805. Validation: 86 distinct local tests, scoped types/lint/format, independent P0/P1 review. Live Telegram acceptance remains unrun. * chore(agents): align CLI result owner for branch integration Temporarily align the two conflicted CLI owner files with current main so GitHub can preserve signed contributor ancestry during integration. The reviewed progress-card candidate will be reapplied after the merge. This is an intermediate integration head, not final validation. * fix(agents): restore reviewed CLI progress checklists Reapply the independently reviewed progress-card candidate after integrating current main while preserving the original contributor ancestry. Preserve normalized checklists, failure summaries, duplicate cleanup, delivery suppression, and final-answer lifecycle. Original fix by chelsealong; fixes #150805. Validation: 86 distinct local tests plus scoped types, lint, formatting and independent review. Live Telegram proof remains pending. * fix(agents): preserve empty progress-card clears Retain explicit empty CLI tool arguments so successful progress-card clears retract the channel checklist. Consume correlated arguments once so duplicate clears cannot erase a newer card. Extend the real parser-to-compositor fixture for canonical and OpenClaw-prefixed names, replacement, suppression, and final delivery. Preserve original contributor ancestry and credit to chelsealong. Validation: 71 affected tests, repository changed-file checks, and independent P0-P2 review pass. Live Telegram acceptance and screenshot delivery remain pending. * chore(agents): align CLI event owner for main integration Temporarily align the conflicted CLI event owner with main so GitHub can preserve signed contributor ancestry. The reviewed progress-card candidate will be reapplied after integration. This intermediate head is not final validation. * fix(agents): keep CLI plans tied to tracked execution Project successful tracked progress-card results with authoritative prepared arguments, preserve explicit clears, and keep display-only or ambiguous calls outside plan state. Preserve tool summaries and final delivery. Includes regressions for both completion orderings, prepared clears and replacements, and ambiguous capture. Contributor ancestry is retained. --------- Co-authored-by: Jason (Json)

items.summary: fix(backup): avoid false owner conflicts for duplicate registry paths (#154006) * fix(backup): accept duplicate paths for one database owner Deduplicate captured core registrations by physical ownership while preserving archive aliases and rejecting distinct owners sharing a database. Keep identity validation for every original registration. Reproduces the enclosing-workspace failure when the registry contains multiple spellings of the same agent database path; enclosure alone succeeds. Thanks @RJAILLC for reporting #153970. * fix(backup): preserve WAL ownership across database aliases Route core and plugin snapshots through the shared WAL-aware source groups, retain the captured global registry image, and validate cached alias copies. Reject transient alias checkpoints through the existing main-file mutation fingerprint. Prove restored WAL-only rows in both pathname orders and recorded refusals for ambiguous journals. Preserve canonical ownership validation and sanitization. Follow-up for #153970; thanks @RJAILLC.

items.title: 北韓駭客組織WaterPlum利用假冒求職感染全球至少3萬臺裝置，竊取千萬美元加密貨幣
items.summary: 美國、日本、澳洲及德國政府9月18日發布聯合公告，揭露北韓駭客組織WaterPlum（又稱Contagious Interview）的攻擊活動。該組織的活動是由日本警方與FBI等單位調查後發現，自2025年12月至2026年7月間，至少感染全球100多國3萬臺裝置，主要鎖定網頁設計師、工程師及加密貨幣、區塊鏈與Web3專業人士，並從超過7,000個加密貨幣錢包竊取資金或憑證，至少已將1,071萬美元加密貨幣轉移至北韓。FBI與日本警方評估認為，WaterPlum及相關北韓IT人員，隸屬於北韓軍需工業部中央委員會第313總局。
